title: Import existing KiCad boards via MCP
summary: New import_kicad tool parses a .kicad_pcb (outline, footprints, pads, nets, design rules, traces/vias/zones) into a live session, returning a document_id ready for render_pcb, run_drc, get_pad_positions, route_nets, and export_gerber. import_eagle is a clear not-yet-supported stub pointing at KiCad export.
